privacyBody:
1. Collected Data: The bot only collects your Discord Server ID and Channel ID to send alerts. No personal messages or server content are read or stored.

2. Website: We use local storage to save your language preference. Traffic stats are anonymous (Umami) with no tracking cookies.

3. Data Usage: Your data is never sold, rented, or shared with third parties.

4. Retention: If you kick the bot, your server data will be automatically deleted during our cleanup cycle. We also use Google AdSense to display ads. Advertising cookies are only set after you accept them through our cookie banner; you can change your choice at any time via 'Cookie settings'.
tosBody:
1. Description: This service is an automated alert bot for free video games.

2. Availability: The service is provided 'as is'. We do not guarantee 100% uptime or the detection of every single offer.

3. Affiliation: This project is independent and is not affiliated with Valve (Steam), Epic Games, GOG, or Discord.

4. Acceptable Use: Any attempt to spam, overload the API, or hack our systems will result in a permanent ban for your server.

5. Modifications: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time.

6. Open Source & Licensing: The source code is open-source under the GNU GPLv3 license. You can view, modify, and distribute it according to these terms on our GitHub (AbelQ11/free-game-deals). This service is provided WITHOUT WARRANTY.
faq1Q: How do I get notified about free PC games?
faq1A: Free Game Deals is an automatic Discord bot that tracks 100% free PC games. Add it to your server to receive instant alerts.
faq2Q: Does the bot track Epic Games and Steam giveaways?
faq2A: Yes! Our game tracker monitors real-time promotions on Steam, Epic Games Store, and official giveaways on GOG.com.
faq3Q: How do I set up the free games Discord bot?
faq3A: Click the invite button, choose your Discord server, and create a text channel named exactly 'free-games'. The bot will handle the rest.
